scripts.dev: tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node -e "const { spawn } = require('node:child_process'); delete process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; const child = spawn(require('electron'), ['dist/electron.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env }); child.on('exit', (code, signal) => process.exit(code ?? (signal ? 1 : 0)));"
scripts.build: rimraf dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.preload.tsbuildinfo && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json
scripts.pack: pnpm run build && pnpm run pack:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json
